abilities.name: anger-point
abilities.effect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

abilities.name: defiant
abilities.effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

kanto.flavorText: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.

original-johto.flavorText: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.

hoenn.flavorText: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

updated-johto.flavorText: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

original-unova.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

updated-unova.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

kalos.flavorText: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: When Primeape becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.

original-alola.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

updated-alola.flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
